## Method and limits
- Window: 2024-06-01 to 2026-05-31 (end exclusive 2026-06-01, censored). The gap to today (2026-10-23) is about 5 months. The data says nothing about Jun–Oct 2026.
- Lane: news only. No research or call-based lanes beyond c1.
- Coverage: table checks passed, but they test reachability, not ingest completeness [c1]. Entity and geography labels stop at 2026-05-01 [c1]; May 2026 fills only about 4% of labels [c1].
- Match mode: "mention" for counts, themes and entities; "central" for the publisher sample and recent/critical lists [c1]. The publisher sample is 200 articles, not the full set.
- Counts are articles mentioning the term, not Indian-only articles; they are not readership or reach. The US, UK and other places show the grain is covered abroad too.
- "Critical" is a classifier flag, and I did not read the articles to verify it. Entities are unverified machine labels, so Modi's 181 mentions may include incidental ones [c1].
- Interpretation: the decline likely reflects the end of the 2023 International Year of Millets news cycle (background knowledge, est.), and I cannot test this from the data. The April 2026 critical spike is tied to the Centre–Tamil Nadu bonus dispute by the headlines, not by a measured causal link.
- Not answerable: sales, consumption or production figures; reader sentiment; Indian-only monthly series.
